The institutional investor held 15,534 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.67 million, up from 5,066 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Mcdonalds Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $127.51B market cap company. The stock increased 0.48% or $0.77 during the last trading session, reaching $162.39. About 3.38M shares traded.
